rows.text: [Detect Magic] — The ward opens under your sight and does not stop opening. It is not holding anything shut. It is POURING: one direction, one slow measured rate, into whatever the stone is between. It has poured since before the city. Pisces, very quietly: "Ah. So that is what the others were."
A hand-painted board, letters gone bold where they were traced twice: THE WANDERING INN — NO KILLING GOBLINS.
You circle the block twice before it clicks. The modest COYLE AND SONS sign faces the boulevard; the two wagons idling round the side face the alley, and the men loading them count every crate twice.

A modest hanging board, burgundy and brass, lettered COYLE AND SONS in a hand that cost more than the paint. The frontage behind it is one narrow door and a clean window. Everything that actually moves through this firm goes round the side, on wagons, after dark.
Shelves of labelled jars, a rented burner, and a hand-lettered card: WORKING SPACE, BY THE HOUR, NO CREDIT.

TRAVELER'S NOTE, pinned crooked. Village called Riverfarm, downriver a fair walk, farming folk, growing fast under some new lord. They've got witch trouble, or so the last one through here said — crops going bad, nobody saying why out loud. No bounty on it, just word passed along. Ask the Guild about the road if you're curious.

A LETTER, sealed in wax gone slightly soft from handling, addressed to no one by name. Inside: impeccable handwriting regrets to inform you of a small disagreement in Invrisil concerning a mutual acquaintance's good name, and would consider it a personal favor — and a professional one — if a stranger to the city might look into it. The witch at Riverfarm keeps the stones, should the distance prove an obstacle. Signed only with a small drawing of a hat. The Guildmistress's clerk says it arrived by very ordinary post, which is itself the strangest part.

A WATCH NOTICE, freshly pinned. The reopened gallery under the old seal is to be surveyed properly before the Council calls it settled — volunteers with Guild standing should see Olesm Swifttail at the frontage desk. Pay is Watch-scale. What 'properly' means is left to the surveyor.
WATCH NOTICE, pinned by a hand in a hurry. Recruit Pell missed second muster running. Ashgrave has it logged as absence for now. Anyone with eyes free, ask at the barracks.

A SCRAP OF PARCHMENT, tacked low, easy to miss. 'LOST: one backup warhammer, plain steel, no love lost between us but I want it back. Ask for Renn. Reward for the honest sort.' The handwriting gets angrier toward the bottom.
THE DELIVERY BOARD. Your slip's still logged at the counter.
THE DELIVERY BOARD. Legs and ledgers. Gold by distance, paid on the mark, same-waking terms. Slips at the counter.
One crate of tin, den shop, market tier. Logged three cycles running and carried none of them. Beside it, chalked in a tidier hand: HELD, QUEUE.
The brass gate is locked. A stencilled plate: PERMIT AND STAMP REQUIRED. The clerk's window is open.
Forty-one attempts. Under the last one, in smaller writing than the rest: TRY THE OTHER WAY ROUND.
The brass gate is locked. A stencilled plate: PERMIT AND STAMP REQUIRED. The clerk's window is open.

ending_shapes.adjacency_rule: §9 rule 4, RULED: 'adjacent' means ENTITY-LIST ORDER. One shape per entity: its `observe` if it has one, else its first narrator string in document order. Grid proximity stays a cold-read lens and is deliberately not computed.

advisory_caps.ruled: 40% single-ending-shape cap per file, advisory; loosen to 50% rather than force churn (bible §9.2 / adjudication row 9.2)

ending_shapes.known_divergence: §9's own table labels 'Nobody came back to make the ninety-third.' a FACT ending; this proxy calls it ABSENCE because `nobody` is an absence token — and §5 itself describes mercantile_alleys' 'nobody left standing beside it' as ending on an absence. The bible's labels are hand judgements; the proxy is consistent, which is what a concentration measure needs. It is a smoke detector, not a verdict.
ending_shapes.method: Ordered proxy over the LAST sentence: interruption (terminal dash / ellipsis / '!') > unresolved (terminal '?') > instruction (imperative first word, or the 'down you go' idiom) > absence (an absence token: nobody/nothing/none/never/empty/gone/missing/silence/silent/unanswered/without/not/no) > motion (a motion verb not preceded by a copula) > fact (DEFAULT, therefore a catch-all).
ending_shapes.scope: §9.2 scopes the per-file cap to SCENIC + FUNCTIONAL strings, so that is the scope here; narrator only.

object_inference.method: An OBJECT is one `$.entities[i]` in one map file, counted when it carries at least one narrator prose string. It 'carries inference' when any of its narrator strings has a four-word anonymous agent (inferred history) or a button smoke score >=2 (thematic interpretation). 22 narrator strings hang off the MAP rather than an entity (`interior_flavor`, `arrival_toasts[].text`) and are excluded from the denominator.

counted.text: Come in, mind the small ones. If you're buying, the shelf is the shelf. If you're official, the counter's there, and it has been a long month already. There's bread in the oven I need to get back to.
It goes still when you crouch, which from a razorbeak is an invitation. Make the offer properly.
He keeps the ledger of who is owed a table rather than who is owed money, which in this house is the more delicate book. He has not written anything down since you came in.
An Antinium of Liscor's Watch — dark chitin, four arms, antennae, twin swords worn at the hips like a closed argument. He stands still the way patient things do.

shared_geometry.gap_fix: RE_WHICH_FROM now allows a 1-3 word noun phrase between the preposition and the copula. 'which from a razorbeak is an invitation' was invisible to the one-word pattern.
shared_geometry.near_miss_note: NOT counted in the metric: a longer noun phrase (4-6 words) or a non-copular verb (means / reads / amounts / makes / becomes / signifies). Listed so a widened regex is a controller decision rather than a silent one.

speaker_motif.graph_anchor_note: The issue states the Pallass anchor about the CITY ('Pallass generally: standards, forms, measurements, queues'), so it is scoped to speakers appearing in a `pallass*` graph rather than to a person.
speaker_motif.method: Per speaker, over that speaker's NODE lines only. Player option rows are excluded (an option row's `speaker` is the NPC whose node offers it, so counting them would file the player's lines under whoever they are talking to), and the 22 `text_bank` rows are excluded with them (the gate's speaker_for() returns its file-level 'narrator' fallback for a bank path). `top` is the single most frequent CONTENT word and its share of the speaker's content words. `issue_anchor` is that speaker's problem-4 anchor list from the issue, expanded to inflections only.

voice_split.rule: SPOKEN = the words are a character's own (node line, player option, option-bank line, map ambient `dialogue[].text`, `friendly_line`). NARRATOR = everything else, including option-effect toasts and `copy` documents. Transport is irrelevant: `friendly_line` ships as a toast and is still the NPC talking.
